summary_1line: Arjuna and Vyasa urge grieving Yudhishthira to follow Kshatriya duty—rule justly, perform sacrifices, and uphold the household order rather than renounce the world.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna speaks firmly to the sorrowful Yudhishthira seated amid the aftermath of war, urging him to rise and rule as a Kshatriya.
The sage Vyasa addresses the silent king, explaining the duties of household life while courtiers listen in a solemn royal hall.
